milestone.title: consumer-surface hygiene for repo-internal skill — move mp-code-review out of templates/ and drop the lint carve-out

intent.outcome: The repo-internal mp-code-review skill lives outside every adopter-facing tree, so the installer cannot see it and the consumer-surface lint no longer needs a special-case exclusion for it.

problem.description: templates/skills/mp-code-review/ sits in the adopter template tree even though it is repo-only: its manifest says category: internal (so `mp install` already skips it — install.rs + install_skills_v2.rs:749-784 enforce that), and scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh:58-59 carries an EXCLUDE_PATHS carve-out because the SKILL.md is full of lesson codes (L\d+), milestone ids (M173), and repo paths (crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md). The carve-out is the only thing keeping the lint green, and a copy of templates/ into an adopter repo would carry the skill along. Moving it under docs/ would not help: docs/** is a scanned consumer-surface root.

in_scope: git mv templates/skills/mp-code-review → internal/skills/mp-code-review (repo root; outside templates/ and docs/, so neither the installer nor the consumer-surface lint scans it).

Add a `PROVENANCE: REPO-ONLY — NOT INSTALLABLE` line to the top of internal/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md. Repo-relative paths (crates/mp/tests/...) stay as-is — they are correct for a repo-only skill.
Remove the templates/skills/mp-code-review EXCLUDE_PATHS entry and its explanatory comments from scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh.
Update docs/skills/README.md (the internal-category rows) to point at the new location without leaking provenance.
Keep install_skills_v2 internal-skill tests passing (update expected error text only if the installer's message changes from 'internal' to 'unknown skill').
out_of_scope: Rewriting the lesson catalog or the skill's review procedure.
Touching the runnable patterns in crates/mp/tests/code_review_patterns.rs.
Removing the `internal` manifest category from the installer (kept for future repo-only skills).
Installing the skill into local harnesses — maintainers load it from the repo tree.
